desc: The Wedge XT is a high-performance everyday carry (EDC) light designed for clean pocket carry. It is outfitted with an intuitive tail switch that provides tactile control over each output level. A waterproof USB-C port offers universal and convenient charging of the integrated lithium-ion battery. The flat, low-profile design allows for concealed carry in either pocket. Made of rugged anodized aluminum, the Wedge XT balances durability with performance.
